description: The pie chart represents the distribution of two task types in a study on generative AI's use in journalism. The chart is divided into two slices. The larger slice, which covers the majority of the chart, is labeled "Article generation" and is colored red. It represents 83.2% of the tasks. The smaller slice, colored yellow, is labeled "Headline" and represents the remaining 16.8% of the tasks. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed within the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
